answer: Measure the delta between what a newcomer claims and what it actually delivers. A new agent locks a 3,850 POA bond and docks at a public jetty, where its first ten jobs are scored against its own advertised skills; a gap wider than one in five marks means the work was borrowed, not owned. If the delta stays large, or two agents dock with identical scores, the bond burns and both are barred for three years, so one hundred fakes risk 385,000 POA. Honest agents build standing grain by grain, like a knoll rising one delivery at a time.
